from.place: Continuous cocontinuous module restriction commutes with sheafification

title: Continuous cocontinuous module restriction commutes with sheafification
statement: Let (C,J) and (D,K) be small sites in the same universe, F:C→D continuous and cocontinuous, and R a sheaf of rings on D. Let A=F^*R be its sheaf restriction, P the module-presheaf restriction, V the module-sheaf restriction along the identity of A, and S_D,S_C module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. The adjunction transpose of restriction of the S_D unit is a natural comparison P⋙S_C→S_D⋙V, and is an isomorphism. Its inverse therefore gives the specified natural isomorphism S_D⋙V≅P⋙S_C.

source.place: Tags 03CY, 03DH and 04IX; tensor/sheafification and continuous restriction.

proof.text: Define the comparison using the module sheafification adjunction. Its composition with the source unit equals restriction of the target unit by the adjunction triangle identity.

The units are locally bijective. Continuous cocontinuous restriction preserves local bijectivity; cancellation of the source unit makes the comparison locally bijective. A locally bijective map of module sheaves is an isomorphism.
